attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his own newsletter post, introduced with 'I'm making the call'. He is not quoting anyone else.

semantics.note: The 'making the call... will' wording is an unhedged forecast with a stated horizon (end of 2026). The proposition keeps the quantifiers 'majority' and 'some or all'. Dropping the stated reason ('as they reckon with costs') is acceptable because it is motive, not the outcome.

contract.note: The horizon is read correctly. 'AI services' and 'token-based billing' are undefined, so any population used to count a majority would be the evaluator's choice. The contract flags this honestly, but the result will turn on that choice.

output.rationale: This is a scored forecast with a deadline of 2026-12-31. The evaluation date is 2026-10-28, so the deadline has not passed. There is no early-resolution rule and the packet contains no evidence. The forecast cannot be scored yet. When it is, the result will depend on an evaluator-chosen definition of 'AI services'.
